text: The knowledge of the deen does not fit into the brain; the brain cannot analyse it correctly. When it settles into the heart, then the brain can see its good and bad; its virtues become evident to the brain. And if it does not go into the heart, then it is as if you are throwing water at a wall: it has no effect inside it, it brings no benefit.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 1, 2014-05-10, 09:16

text: The knowledge of the heart has no lines in it; in it there are states, feelings. For it too a teacher should be sought: some accomplished Sheikh whose own heart is alive and who has the capacity to bring another's heart to life. And if one learns from him, then this too gets going.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 1, 2014-05-10, 28:20

text: When light comes into the heart, its effect reaches the limbs and even one's thinking: you begin to think rightly, you begin to act rightly, and evils begin to fall away.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 2, 2014-05-20, 13:16

text: If someone, even sitting at home, begins to say Allah, Allah with a sincere heart (Allah the Most Generous has said: those who strive for Us, for Our pleasure, We show them the ways), if he begins at home, Allah will bring him to some such person who will train him. This is Allah's promise; let anyone try it and see.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 6, 2014-06-15, 23:22

text: For salvation, the Kalima Tayyiba, prayer, fasting and lawful earnings are enough. Salvation is one thing; acceptance in the court of Divinity and access to the court of the Holy Prophet ﷺ is another matter; it has its own delight.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 6, 2014-06-15, 28:35

text: Sin is ignorance, foolishness. Even if a scholar commits a sin, at the time of sinning he too is ignorant: he forgets the greatness of Allah. But for sin there is repentance.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 7, 2014-06-20, 17:33

text: My brother, praise be to Allah, our breath is still going and our senses are intact. Before our faculties give way and the breath breaks, we have to make this decision, about ourselves, not about others, about ourselves: where do I stand, and where ought I to be?
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 7, 2014-06-20, 26:04

text: The deen is a most beautiful and easiest prescription for living life: that in this world too you live with ease and comfort and honour and dignity and peace, and gain Paradise for free.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 7, 2014-06-20, 27:33

text: The first thing is this: remember it with certainty, that until the final breath, until the last breath, man is under trial.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 11, 2014-07-20, 23:24

text: Man is limited; his asking too is limited; he is a creation. Allah is the Creator; His giving too is His attribute, and it is unlimited; it has no end.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 12, 2014-07-25, 15:44

text: The reality of dua, the real essence of dua, is this: that we are granted the honour of speaking with Allah. Here the servant is directly addressing the Lord of the worlds with folded hands.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 13, 2014-08-01, 28:51

text: Ma'rifat means recognition: that one knows the favours of Allah. Then love for Him will come into him by itself, and he will not feel like disobeying Him.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 16, 2014-08-20, 17:40

text: Death is not the name of annihilation; it is the name of moving from one realm to another. We were in a particle of dust, we came into the father's loins, and the realm in the dust was left behind. We went into the mother's womb, and the connection with the father's loins was left behind. From the mother's womb we came into the world, then no connection with the mother's womb remained. From the world we went into Barzakh. So just as we have been coming from behind, we moved forward; it is not annihilation.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 17, 2014-08-25, 21:42

text: If the attention is towards worldly affairs, then zikr has not happened; it will be a practice, an exercise. Your lungs will gain health, energy will come into your body, the muscles will become strong. The heart will find peace only when the whole attention is in the zikr; when there is attention in the zikr, then the heart will find peace.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 17, 2014-08-25, 31:14

text: Our misfortune is that all our life we keep nourishing and protecting the body, and we do not care at all about the wounds of the soul, although it should be cared for more than the body.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 18, 2014-09-01, 02:59

text: Now, we count as sin only what we can see. We commit countless sins of which we are not even aware, which we consider permissible and they are not permissible. So the cure for all of this is repentance alone; and repentance is a state that takes the servant into the presence of Allah, and then he does not dare to disobey.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 20, 2014-09-20, 27:09

text: Merely saying with the tongue, 'O Allah, I repent,' has no meaning. When one repents, let him think: is there some mistake in my belief, is it correct? Is there some mistake in my character? If he desists from it, then this is repentance.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 20, 2014-09-20, 27:58

text: The heart of a believer is illuminated with the light of faith, so it needs to be protected all the more: if even a small splash falls on it, it is seen from afar.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 20, 2014-09-20, 29:27

text: The polish of hearts is the zikr of Allah. So, brother, polish your hearts, do the zikr of Allah. When hearts are clean, love will stay settled in them. If the heart has become rusted, then what love? Then hatreds will be born there, and you go about quarrelling and fighting with everyone.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 21, 2014-09-25, 03:38

text: Wilayat is this: that someone's heart becomes so strongly connected to the most pure heart of the Holy Prophet ﷺ that the states of that most pure heart begin to come into this heart; and then from his thoughts, from his tongue, from his limbs, from his character, their fragrance begins to come and their glimpse begins to be seen.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 22, 2014-10-01, 08:10

text: One whose faith is sound and whose deeds are righteous (that is, faith is the claim and character is its witness), so one whose deeds are in keeping with his faith has, to a degree, the friendship of Allah (wilayat).
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 22, 2014-10-01, 27:07

text: A very fine point is this: in the company of the Sheikh, benefit comes only when your heart stays turned towards the Sheikh. Sitting in the Sheikh's company you are thinking, what will happen at my shop today? The heart is at the shop, the body is in the Sheikh's company; what benefit will there be?
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 23, 2014-10-05, 09:30

text: The hereafter is our real home. We have come here to earn for there. We are earning it here and sending it on. Now, what are we sending?
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 24, 2014-10-10, 10:51

text: The fear of Allah is this: that your relationship with Allah be such, your bond and connection with Allah be such, that while speaking, while working, a bell rings at once: let no such word leave my mouth that Allah becomes displeased; let me not do such a deed that Allah becomes displeased. This is the fear that is meant.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 24, 2014-10-10, 14:16

text: When one does a good deed with sincerity of heart, he will feel the bitterness of sin and taste the sweetness of goodness. When he tastes the sweetness of goodness, this is ma'rifat.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 24, 2014-10-10, 16:57

text: In the mother's womb, when the heart is formed it starts beating, whether the rest of the body is complete or not. When the heart is complete it starts beating, and it keeps beating until the edge of the grave; it does the most work. When each of its beats is taught 'Allah', it becomes abundant zikr.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 25, 2014-10-15, 22:44

text: If you want to live in hearts, then make your place in the court of Allah and settle Allah in your heart; a place will be made for you in every heart.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 26, 2014-10-25, 30:06

text: Where there is love, the very first quality of love is that it has no desire of its own; it is selfless.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 26, 2014-10-25, 31:04

text: Illuminate the heart with the remembrance of Allah, and settle the light of Allah in the heart so much that your reliance comes to be on Allah. For worldly needs, do adopt lawful means: if there is illness, do go to the doctor, pay the fee, take the medicine; the reliance will be on Allah.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 27, 2014-11-25, 03:22

text: On the path of sulook, my son, there is no difficulty. Walking the path of sulook, there is no difficulty. It has been fifty-five years for me; alhamdulillah, I have not seen any difficulty.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 27, 2014-11-25, 12:53

text: A servant is a receiving end. Blessings and mercies are raining down all the time; now, however much capacity one has, that much he will receive.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 30, 2014-12-15, 06:17

text: The spirit of fasting is this: that the body be purified and the soul too be refined, that impurities be lifted from it and angelic qualities be produced.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 30, 2014-12-15, 09:27

text: So, to accept Allah when reason is left helpless is one thing; but to accept Allah's Being and Attributes as He is, for that a Prophet is needed.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 31, 2014-12-20, 03:21

text: And what is worship? To obey Allah and the Holy Prophet ﷺ from the depth of the heart. So this deed in itself becomes a supplication. It asks for Allah's mercy, it asks for blessings, it asks for rewards; it itself becomes a supplication.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 31, 2014-12-20, 29:08

text: Our weakness is that, first of all, we read the Qur'an very little; there are very few people who recite it, and those who do recite merely for the sake of reciting. We do not have this very concept: that this Book is in Arabic, I should understand it in my own language; it is saying something to me, it is demanding something, it is explaining things to me, it is teaching something.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 33, 2015-01-01, 11:00

text: Islam is not the name of 'ilm al-yaqin (certainty by knowledge) alone. Islam is the name of this: whatever you have heard that the Holy Prophet ﷺ said, try it out and see, test it and see; then at the very least it will take you to 'ayn al-yaqin (certainty by sight).
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 33, 2015-01-01, 20:40

text: Zikr of the Personal Name (Ism-e-Zat) is the only means by which you connect with Allah directly, and His essential manifestations (tajalliyat-e-zati) can come upon your heart.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 34, 2015-01-06, 05:07

text: We cannot sin in front of a human being, so why do we do it in front of Allah? Because these words are in our minds; the reality is not in our hearts. The ma'rifat that tasawwuf speaks of is this: that the reality of these words descends into the heart, and one becomes certain that all of this is exactly so.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 35, 2015-01-13, 03:19

text: The question is: what is the tasbih that gets accepted? It is the tasbih that changes his whole system of life.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 35, 2015-01-13, 10:56

text: Love is this: that you become so devoted to something that you have no concern left for your own gain or loss, whether gain comes or loss comes. Where there is gain and loss, there is no love; there, there are needs.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 36, 2015-01-20, 02:07

text: The special quality of acts of worship is that they strengthen your connection with Allah; and then, when you go out into the world, into the field of life's action, you work according to Allah's will.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 37, 2015-02-01, 16:31

text: Worship stops one from evil and indecency. A connection of yours becomes such that when you set about any work, there is the presence of the Real; you see Allah near you.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 37, 2015-02-01, 16:50

text: What are these rights of the servants (huquq al-'ibad)? What are the rights of people? Who has given them? If their rights too were fixed by Allah Himself, then these too have become the rights of Allah.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 39, 2015-02-10, 26:29

text: The rule of the Shariah is that a teacher has a dignity; for a student, to learn, adab (respect) is a condition.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 40, 2015-02-15, 07:07

text: Look, every word that comes out of the mouth, every deed that we do, has an effect of its own: either light or darkness. If it is in accordance with obedience to Allah and the Sunnah of the Holy Prophet ﷺ, light is born of it; if it is against it, blackness is born of it, darkness is born of it.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 42, 2015-02-25, 02:12

text: Look for nearness to Allah in your character. If you come even one inch closer to Allah from where you stand, your character will change. The closer you keep going, the brighter and more radiant your character will become.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 42, 2015-02-25, 22:45

text: Calamity comes when, after making the effort, we also want our own decision to prevail, and our decision collides with the decree of Allah; then it becomes a calamity.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 43, 2015-03-01, 24:33

text: Everything has a polish, and the polish of hearts is the zikr of Allah. Keep doing Allah Allah; the heart will become clean, and then what you have accepted with the mind, the heart will also accept. When the heart accepts, character keeps being moulded into that shape.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 43, 2015-03-01, 27:38

text: The real thing is that we find it easy to object to others, but we do not find it easy to fulfil our own responsibility.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 48, 2015-04-01, 15:30

text: It is the difference between qaal (word) and haal (state). If the one who speaks also acts on it himself, the word goes down into the heart.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 48, 2015-04-01, 30:11

text: Every deed that you do according to the Shariah has two effects: it becomes food and medicine for the body, and along with that, food for the soul as well.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 49, 2015-04-05, 03:15

text: If you act against the Shariah and do as you please, the soul will keep growing sick; it may even die, because the death of the soul is distance from faith.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 49, 2015-04-05, 04:07

text: Allah Kareem has given the prescription for producing sincerity: do the zikr of Allah, remember Allah, do Allah Allah; from this, contentment, peace and sincerity are born in the heart. Now, in our days and nights of twenty-four hours, if we take out even twenty-four minutes and, cut off from everything and fully focused, simply sit and do Allah Allah Allah, sincerity will be born.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 52, 2015-04-20, 21:35

text: I often say: in a life of billions of years, if you did spend a hundred years in luxury and pleasure, what did you achieve? And there is no luxury here either.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 52, 2015-04-20, 29:38

text: Prayer is a medicine; sin is a disease. Now if the medicine is taken and the disease still keeps growing, it means the medicine is not right.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 54, 2015-05-01, 27:38

text: The world is deen when it is done according to Allah's command. Earning a living, feeding the children, serving one's parents: every task of the world, when it comes within the bounds of the Shariah, becomes deen; it becomes worship.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 55, 2015-05-10, 19:32

text: It may be that we see ten sins of a person, but he has done a good deed that outweighs those ten sins, that is greater, and we do not know of it. That is why we are not the ones to hold others to account. Do not hold others to account; hold yourself to account.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 55, 2015-05-10, 22:18

text: Taqwa, or the fear of Allah, is the fear of a crack coming into a relationship: that I have a bond with my Allah, and not even a hairline crack should come into it.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 56, 2015-05-15, 03:48

text: Whoever believed, whether man or woman, child or old, scholar or unlettered, rich or poor: whoever, with faith, received a glance from the Holy Prophet ﷺ became a Companion.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 56, 2015-05-15, 30:42

text: Paradise is not sought for its own sake. Paradise is sought because it will be given to the one who is granted Allah's pleasure, with whom Allah is pleased, whom Allah forgives.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 57, 2015-05-20, 05:10

text: These spiritual states are not things for writing and reading, for asking about or for telling; they are things to be done.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 57, 2015-05-20, 12:33

text: This is the property of the light of faith: even if there are some small weaknesses in a person, they begin to go away, and he sets out towards good.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 59, 2015-06-01, 28:33

text: Allah says: whoever believes, I am his friend. Now it is his task to keep up the friendship. The certificate of friendship has come from Allah; now it is his task not to disturb the friendship, not to go against His wishes, not to go against His liking, not to disobey His command.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 59, 2015-06-01, 29:15

text: The reward of every single moment is given at that very moment. Say Allah once, and a hundred spiritual states come upon the heart; make one prostration, and thousands of kinds of divine manifestations come into the heart.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 60, 2015-06-15, 17:06

text: The greatest affliction is to go astray. The greatest affliction is that a person sets out on the road to Hell, and worship saves him from that.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 60, 2015-06-15, 17:58

text: If this awareness comes alive, that I am standing before the Lord of the worlds, then the stray thoughts would go away.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 61, 2015-06-20, 23:23

text: One thing is to affirm with the tongue, another is to accept with the heart. If the heart accepts, then he does not perform the Islamic obligations as a mere formality; he performs all of them from the heart. Then he has become a believer.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 62, 2015-06-25, 06:42

text: One has to go to a person whose own heart is engaged in zikr and who also has the capacity to make the hearts of others engaged. This is a lamp lit from a lamp; it does not start by itself, so these blessings have to be received. But the capacity for it is present in every person, and it remains until death.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 63, 2015-07-01, 25:10

text: The proper way to read the verses is that every reader should understand: my Lord is addressing me.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 64, 2015-07-15, 05:20

text: The more one feels the greatness of Allah, the more the ego ends. Now for this, make the heart one that does zikr: do Allah Allah, learn Allah Allah, do zikr. The states that come from the blessings of prophethood bring out the greatness of Allah and end egotism.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 64, 2015-07-15, 18:48

text: Those whom we consider righteous take no time to make a mistake, and those whom we consider bad take no time to repent. This matter is between the servant and Allah.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 66, 2015-07-20, 02:34

text: Making dua is itself a state of nearness to Allah. And even if nothing at all is gained from dua, is it a small thing that you get to speak directly with Allah?
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 68, 2015-07-31, 06:53

text: You are not to look at what effect it has; you are to look at with how much sincerity, and how much, you passed on the word of Allah and of the Holy Prophet ﷺ. Allah will give you the reward for that.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 68, 2015-07-31, 19:42

text: And He is so generous that if you ask of Him, He is pleased with you; if you do not ask, He is displeased: you have such audacity that you do not even ask of Me! So asking is in itself worship.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 69, 2015-08-05, 02:29

text: Whatever work you are doing, let it not be only to show people; rather, you are doing it from the depth of the heart. This is tasawwuf.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 70, 2015-08-10, 17:56

text: The reality of prayer is that you speak directly to the Most Generous Lord. And if you are in distress or in illness, then you should make your request with even more feeling from the heart.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 71, 2015-08-15, 03:22

text: The world itself is temporary, passing. The successes of the world are passing too, its sorrows are passing too, its joys are passing too. Lasting happiness comes from success in the hereafter.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 71, 2015-08-15, 10:11

text: Shirk happens when we attach our hopes to other than Allah. So at times even our worship becomes shirk: when we want to make long, long prostrations so that people are pleased by it and become my devotees, then Allah's pleasure no longer remains there; people's pleasure has become the aim, so this too will become shirk.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 72, 2015-08-20, 18:53

text: As long as this information stays in the mind, it is news; when it descends into the heart, it is knowledge. The hallmark of knowledge is that it is acted upon.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 73, 2015-08-25, 13:25

text: Life is a great blessing of Allah, in that you have respite to make up for what has been lost, respite to reform yourself, respite to repent, respite for forgiveness.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 74, 2015-09-01, 02:09

text: Recite a wazifa so that my intention becomes right; recite a wazifa so that I gain benefit in the hereafter from it; recite a wazifa so that my character becomes right. Then there will be benefit in this world as well, and in the hereafter as well.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 74, 2015-09-01, 26:36

text: The greatest karamat of a friend of Allah is that he follows the Holy Prophet ﷺ as much as he can and his life is in accordance with the Sunnah. This is the greatest karamat of a wali.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 75, 2015-09-10, 16:15

text: My brother, the meaning of the sending of prophethood and messengership and of the revelation of the Qur'an is that the heart be so filled that Satan does not even pass by that way.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 76, 2015-09-15, 16:44

text: If we want justice, then first we ourselves will have to accept justice and bring justice into our own lives: in our relationships, in our livelihood, in our business, in our friendship and enmity, we will have to bring justice, bring balance.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 77, 2015-09-20, 09:37

text: The month of Ramadan ended, so the fasting ended; but the states you received in Ramadan, in that fasting, if you cannot increase them, then do not waste them.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 78, 2015-09-25, 23:23

text: Be it a fast or any act of worship, the proof of its acceptance is that you are granted nearness to Allah.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 79, 2015-10-01, 03:12

text: The more sincerely from the heart one follows the Holy Prophet ﷺ, the more beloved of Allah he will become. When Allah holds him beloved, he will begin to love Allah.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 80, 2015-10-05, 22:09

text: Such a relationship should form with Allah that, present or absent, travelling or at home, a person keeps in mind: let me not utter this word, Allah will be displeased; let me not do this deed this way, Allah will be displeased. This is called taqwa.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 82, 2015-10-15, 22:05

text: Trust is not placed in the means; trust is placed in the Causer of the means. So adopting the means is worship, obedience to Allah, whatever is within one's own power. After that, one should expect a good result from Allah.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 84, 2015-10-25, 16:29

text: Being granted the ability to do zikr, being granted the ability to pray, and performing it with care is itself the proof that Allah likes it; that is why He has given permission.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 87, 2015-11-05, 20:20

text: We do good and faith grows strong; faith grows strong and the heart wants to do more good.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 89, 2015-11-15, 17:22

text: There is a zikr of the heart; it is the greatest zikr. It encompasses everything, it affects everything; it brings sweetness into prayer, absorption into recitation, and creates luminosity. So, brother, learn the zikr of the heart from a man of the heart.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 89, 2015-11-15, 24:15

text: Faith is the life of the soul; if faith is lost, know that the soul has died.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 90, 2015-11-20, 26:15

text: It is good: before the dua, recite Durood Sharif with sincerity; at the end of the dua, recite Durood Sharif with sincerity. Durood Sharif is a dua that is never rejected.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 92, 2015-11-30, 30:49

text: Learn Allah Allah, do Allah Allah: the heart will be illuminated, breadth will come into it, the greatness of Allah will be perceived; then one will grasp this: whoever did whatever, my Lord is watching.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 93, 2015-12-01, 19:27

text: Every believing servant meets Allah when he is remembering Allah from the depth of his heart, when he stands for prayer with his hands folded.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 94, 2015-12-05, 27:48

text: Whoever you do good to, do it for the pleasure of Allah. Allah will be pleased; Allah will create ease for you, will remove your difficulties, and will grant you the ability to do good.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 94, 2015-12-05, 31:49

text: If someone's good deed is accepted, he is granted the ability to do more good.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 95, 2015-12-10, 14:40

text: Every deed is a supplication; every single act of worship is a supplication. Raising the hands to ask is a separate manner; it has its own sweetness. Every deed is either a supplication or an insolence, a sin; there is no path in between.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 95, 2015-12-10, 29:47

text: Trying to perceive the greatness of Allah, reflecting on His perfections spread throughout His world, and understanding oneself, what am I: this very reflection is muraqaba.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 96, 2015-12-15, 11:09

text: The same thing becomes a calamity, and the same thing becomes a trial, according to the standing of the servant.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 97, 2015-12-20, 03:22

text: We have in fact become extremists: if we make friendship, it is to the farthest extremes, and if we are displeased, we go as far as enmity. In between there is a path, of moderation.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 98, 2015-12-25, 19:05

text: Guarding the tongue is essential; of the means that bring you into Allah's grip, the greatest means is the tongue.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 101, 2016-01-20, 06:55

text: There should be no despair. In the court of Allah there is great mercy, and very vast is His mercy. One should always keep hope.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 101, 2016-01-20, 25:11

text: What is the world? It is the name for heedlessness of Allah. Having wealth and riches, having a wife and children, having a home: this is not the world. The world is the name for being heedless of the greatness of Allah.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 102, 2016-01-25, 28:23

text: Durood is in fact a supplication: O Allah, send down mercies and blessings upon Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 102, 2016-01-25, 30:06

text: Believing is the life of the soul; in practical life, following the Messenger ﷺ is the strengthening of the soul. The more good you do, the more alive it is, the healthier it is, the more awake it is.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 103, 2016-01-31, 13:35

text: It does not mean that if there is no sincerity, then give up the good deed. Do not give it up; keep doing it. Some day Allah will grant sincerity too.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 103, 2016-01-31, 19:42

text: When light comes into the heart, when noor comes, the darkness will leave by itself. You will not have to do anything to send the darkness away; strive to bring in the noor.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 109, 2016-02-20, 21:39

text: Durood Sharif is the supplication that is accepted, and only accepted. So you are saying something that has already found acceptance in the court of Allah.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 109, 2016-02-20, 33:02

text: Goodness, honesty or integrity you do not practise for people; you practise them in obedience to Allah, and to please Allah and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 110, 2016-02-25, 25:28

text: Where we see this difficulty, that a single person has been surrounded by thousands of devils, there is also this ease: Allah takes every believer into His protection. Let him be faithful to Allah, and the matter is settled.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 111, 2016-02-25, 36:41

text: What must be seen is this: I claim love, but is my conduct not disrespect? For the result will come from deeds, not from words.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 112, 2016-02-28, 25:23

text: Let Islam show in your appearance, let it show in your dress, let it show in your manners, let Islam show in your character.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 113, 2016-03-01, 14:03

text: The heart will have to be cleansed, it will have to be polished, so that the heart perceives that my Allah is present with me.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 114, 2016-03-03, 09:31

text: The centre of tasawwuf is the pure breast of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. The Companions (RA) are its trustees; the Tabi'in, the Tabi' Tabi'in and the noble Mashaikh are its trustees. The treasure is there; these are its servants, servants of that court; they take from there and give. My brother, no one has anything of his own.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 114, 2016-03-03, 34:23

text: If He has written illness in your lot, that does not mean He is displeased; perhaps in return for it He wants to give you some very great reward.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 115, 2016-03-25, 19:25

text: The life of the soul lies in soundness of belief and soundness of deeds. When your belief is right, the soul has received life; when your character is right, strength has come into it.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 115, 2016-03-25, 28:16

text: Whether knowledge is of the world or of religion, its only outcome is that one comes to know the greatness of Allah according to one's knowledge.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 116, 2016-03-31, 31:36

text: It is Allah who has to do the work; for it, adopt lawful means. When you adopt unlawful means, this will be proof that your trust is not in Allah; it is in the means.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 117, 2016-04-01, 08:21

text: The effect of company is also influenced by your attention; the more attentively you sit in company, the greater and quicker the effect.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 119, 2016-04-02, 27:15

text: Scholars satisfy the mind; they can give proofs and explain facts. The Sufis, instead of the mind, satisfy the heart and pour a spiritual state into it.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 119, 2016-04-02, 29:38

text: Pride after doing good comes when, having done good to someone, one reminds him of the favour. If it is done for obedience to Allah, a feeling of gratitude comes.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 120, 2016-04-04, 18:41

text: By doing Allah Allah, breadth comes into one's vision, breadth comes into one's knowledge; courage is granted, patience is granted.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 120, 2016-04-04, 22:37

text: Until there is zikr of the heart, there is no abundant zikr. When the name of Allah settles into every beat of the heart, only then does it become the abundant zikr that the Qur'an commands.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 122, 2016-04-06, 03:29

text: Keep your own dealings clean; be concerned about yourself. It is a very great Court. You are using countless blessings; in every single breath you are using millions of blessings. What answer will you give?
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 122, 2016-04-06, 29:32

text: O my brother, perfect is the Being of Allah; what perfection can anyone else have? A servant is needy at every moment and in every place. Perfect is the one who has no need of anyone, and that is the glory of Allah alone.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 123, 2016-04-08, 26:59

text: Even if we have made mistakes, let us take hold of ourselves; the mercy of Allah is waiting for us.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 125, 2016-04-11, 17:46

text: Repentance is accepted in every case, but the conditions of repentance are these: that belief is correct, conduct is correct, and that one then does not commit that sin again and again.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 125, 2016-04-11, 19:55

text: Yes: receiving blessings from the people of Allah, the fear of Allah entering the heart, love for Allah arising, setting out on the path of Allah; this is the only purpose of keeping a bond with the people of Allah.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 126, 2016-08-04, 07:32

text: If your heart flees from sin, then it has sight; it is hearing and it is seeing. If it does not flee from sin, it is blind and deaf.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 127, 2016-08-05, 08:03

text: See, the world is a market, and countless goods are sold in it; good things too can be obtained. This precious life is our capital. Every breath we have is a banknote, a coin. Spending this wealth moment by moment, we are picking up things from the market of the world. Allah has set this test: there are good things and there are bad things too.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 128, 2016-08-06, 13:06

text: Acquire zikr of the heart. The heart will become a zakir; then you will keep on working, and it will keep on saying Allah, Allah.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 131, 2016-08-08, 17:12

text: Allah solves everyone's difficulties. A pir does not mean solving difficulties; a pir means guiding a person towards Allah.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 132, 2016-08-09, 25:16

text: Difficulties are part of life, and they are necessary. If there were no difficulties in life, life itself would become a burden.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 132, 2016-08-09, 26:29

text: If obedience to the Prophethood is adopted as far as one is able, it is no favour to the Holy Prophet ﷺ, nor to Allah; it is faithfulness to oneself.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 134, 2016-08-10, 30:57

text: If there is sincerity, there will be conduct. Sincerity does not exist without conduct; conduct can exist without sincerity. You can imitate, you can put on a show, you can appear righteous outwardly while not being righteous within. Conduct exists even without sincerity, but sincerity does not exist without conduct. If there is sincerity, better conduct will come with it.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 134, 2016-08-10, 31:49

text: The relationship with Allah is not emotional; the relationship with Allah is real: knowingly, with understanding, after thinking it through and analysing it. So whatever is done deliberately, after thinking it through and analysing it, does not diminish.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 135, 2016-08-13, 32:29

text: The real spirit of i'tikaf is that one cuts off completely from the creation and turns towards the Creator.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 136, 2016-08-14, 13:50

text: Eid is an occasion of joy, an occasion of gratitude, and also a reason to sit together. And true joy is the joy in which you make others share.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 137, 2016-08-15, 07:18

text: There is a very long discussion about gratitude, about what gratitude to Allah is, and there are countless sayings on it; but the summary of them all is that gratitude to Allah is obedience to Him. Outside obedience there is no concept of gratitude.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 137, 2016-08-15, 33:57

text: You have a soul; it has come into your body. How have you treated it? This is what will be asked, this is what you will have to answer, and this is the answer you must learn.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 139, 2016-08-21, 14:15

text: The bai'at of tasawwuf is necessary because you have to receive spiritual states from someone's heart. You will receive them if there is a bond with him, and you will receive them if he has them.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 139, 2016-08-21, 17:17

text: Recognise Allah, know Allah. When you know Him, love is its inevitable result.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 140, 2016-08-22, 32:15

text: Allah has left the zikr of Allah unrestricted; it is the one worship in which there is no restriction.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 140, 2016-08-22, 34:51

text: Repentance is that which becomes a lesson for the future: the evil is left behind and you take up good.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 141, 2016-09-04, 06:03

text: This world is an examination hall; each of us is writing his own paper. How many marks it will get is the examiner's work, the examiner's work, the work of the one who gives the marks.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 142, 2016-09-05, 01:50

text: Follow a friend of Allah, read his sayings, do whatever he did, and you too can become a friend of Allah.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 143, 2016-09-06, 18:32

text: Repentance is not merely a word; repentance is the name of an action: that the wrong already done is made good, if that is possible, and that it is not repeated in future.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 144, 2016-09-08, 02:11

text: Gathering many things in the mind is information. All the knowledge people have is at the level of information, not at the level of knowledge. Knowledge is that which is acted upon. If it descends into the heart, it becomes knowledge, and the person acts on it.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 144, 2016-09-08, 18:41

text: If Allah Allah is done and there is sincerity in it, it takes one to the people of Allah.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 145, 2016-09-09, 14:55

text: Love longs for union. It longs to see the Beloved face to face, it longs to converse with the Beloved, it longs to be annihilated in the Beloved.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 147, 2016-10-04, 17:21

text: We say Subhan Allah once: how much is built in Paradise from it, we cannot estimate. We make one sajdah: how much is built for us from it, we cannot estimate.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 148, 2016-10-04, 26:23

text: Yes, wilayat (sainthood) is this: that istihdar is attained. Istihdar means coming to the certainty that Allah is with you at all times, that Allah is present.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 149, 2016-10-07, 17:34

text: If you become pure for the body by taking a bath, then for the soul, the bath of the soul is repentance. Repent with sincerity: 'Whatever has happened, may Allah forgive it; I will not do it again.' Give up that sin from now on, and the soul too is bathed and made pure.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 150, 2016-10-05, 12:17

text: A pir, a scholar or a religious guide is one who corrects your belief and guides you in your conduct; the work is yours to do.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 150, 2016-10-05, 31:15

text: Give everyone their right. Whatever duty falls upon a person is the right of someone or other.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 153, 2016-10-20, 18:11

text: The first thing in the soul is that life comes to it through the light of faith. Now the soul will be alive; now, like the body, it will feel hunger. What is the food of the soul? Obedience to Allah. When you do good, it will be food for the soul and medicine too. If you eat wholesome food, halal, pure and healthy food, the body will be strong; through righteous deeds the soul will be strong.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 154, 2016-11-01, 14:04

text: These spiritual states are not given by writing them on paper; states are not given by confining them in words, nor by telling and hearing. These are feelings that travel from heart to heart.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 157, 2016-11-23, 31:41

text: Education too is complete only when you teach the child the world and, along with it, teach religion too. Upbringing is complete only when you reform yourself.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 158, 2016-11-29, 09:11

text: When the heart becomes a zakir, son, it affects the character; it begins to hate evil.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 159, 2016-12-05, 15:34

text: Keeping attention constant is difficult, and it needs much experience. By doing it again and again, Allah brings it about and it is attained. This is how it happens: it breaks and forms, then at last it becomes permanent. Work hard.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 159, 2016-12-05, 25:02

text: What is the religion of Islam? To use all the things of the world according to the way told by their Maker: that is Islam. Islam teaches all the worldly sciences.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 160, 2016-12-06, 13:56

text: By doing zikr the chance of error becomes less; a person does not become an angel. There are two things: the heedless one makes more mistakes, the zakir makes fewer. The second is that the heedless one does not care about a mistake; if the zakir makes a mistake, he repents, turns back and tries to put it right.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 161, 2016-12-18, 32:12

text: Tawakkul is this: adopt the means that are lawful in the Shariah, and do not think, 'I have done it, so this is the result that will come.' He will give the result.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 161, 2016-12-18, 36:48

text: Allah the Generous commands, 'Do this,' and we do not do it. So look at sin in this light: whose disobedience is it? Then even the smallest disobedience becomes a very great crime.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 162, 2016-12-20, 20:26

text: My brother, whether one is a friend of Allah or a scholar of religion, a godly scholar or a scholar of the outward, there must be some guide. One who has no guide will follow his desires.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 162, 2016-12-20, 26:07

text: Child, everything is decreed by Allah, but a person is obliged to keep up his effort; the results come from Allah the Generous.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 163, 2016-12-30, 12:21

text: A verbal announcement is not repentance; repentance is to leave all that conduct and put your character right.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 163, 2016-12-30, 15:32

text: Paradise, or the Hereafter, is a reward, not a wage. Whoever obeys will receive a further reward, and that reward is Paradise. Paradise is not a wage; the wage we have already received.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 168, 2017-01-09, 37:00

text: The real aim is the life of the soul; the body is only an instrument for the soul's use. A guest comes to you riding a horse; you massage the horse, give it grain, give it water to drink, and do not even ask after the rider. What kind of way is this? If his horse is being served this much, the rider should be served more than that.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 173, 2017-03-07, 24:56

text: From an ordinary Muslim to a friend of Allah or a very chosen servant, the foundation of everyone's faith is belief in the Unseen.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 176, 2017-03-21, 09:42

text: We pray because it is Allah's command; and in prayer there is a connection with Allah, its lights come upon the heart, and the strength to avoid evil and to do good is born.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 177, 2017-04-04, 27:16

text: The murshid teaches you; the murshid is not Allah; he shows the way to Allah, and no one learns without being shown.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 177, 2017-04-04, 32:49

text: A thing that is thrown aside and not used gets eaten by rust. So if no attention is paid to the heart either, if zikr is not done and sins are committed, rust comes upon it.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 178, 2017-04-08, 27:13

text: The Holy Prophet ﷺ made it clear: there is only one way, one, only one: mould yourself in following the Holy Prophet ﷺ, and become the beloved of Allah.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 180, 2017-04-19, 27:59

text: My child, if the soul is alive, then one also becomes aware of spiritual diseases. What diseases does a dead person have? A person who has died, have you ever investigated his diseases? If he is alive, it becomes known; one finds doctors too and searches out medicines too. First bring the soul to life.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 182, 2017-05-06, 19:08

text: My child, we buy troubles. Troubles should not be bought; they do not come into the home by force. When we abandon following the Messenger ﷺ, wherever we abandon it, there a trouble comes.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 184, 2017-05-13, 16:18

text: To give up sin and gird oneself for worship is hard, isn't it? Allah says that with this hardship there are many eases; then many rewards are received.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 185, 2017-06-01, 20:53

text: If you do evil, the decision is yours, and you bear the result of that decision. If you do good, the decision is yours; for it you receive reward.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 185, 2017-06-01, 31:51

text: If one hears a verse of the Qur'an about Hell and the body trembles as though we were standing on fire, and hears of Paradise and the heart blossoms with joy, then that is something.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 186, 2017-06-02, 07:15

text: Repent with sincerity; ask Allah the Generous for forgiveness; He knows your state. Keep your matter with your Master, not with people. Do not show it to people, do not tell them. Repent with a true heart, and refrain from it in future. He is Generous, the One who forgives.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 187, 2017-06-10, 17:38

text: The higher the rank, the more necessary the observance. And all the friends of Allah take more care than others over praying in congregation, over its time, and over offering the prayer correctly.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 189, 2017-06-29, 16:21

text: The act of the heart is unceasing. Once it starts, it keeps going: sleeping and waking, rising and sitting, walking about, the zikr does not stop, provided the heart becomes one that does zikr.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 193, 2017-07-29, 18:08

text: Rizq is every blessing that a person receives from Allah. Life-span is rizq too, children are rizq too, health is rizq too, life is rizq too, the days and nights are rizq too, and the greatest rizq is recognition of the Truth.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 193, 2017-07-29, 32:40

text: Fear of Allah means the fear of a crack coming into the relationship; that is, love for someone is of such a degree that you cannot bear that even one sentence should leave your mouth that would cast a slur on that love.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 193, 2017-07-29, 33:12

text: So, brother, the zikr of Allah is the life of the heart, its food too and its medicine too. And just as oxygen is necessary for life, the zikr of Ism-e-Zaat is necessary to keep the heart alive.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 194, 2017-08-03, 05:42

text: There is no charity from haram wealth, no good deed. Its means too should be halal: the sources and means of a good deed should be halal.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 197, 2017-08-24, 24:06

text: Wilayat is acquired. It depends on a person's character, his belief, his effort and his teacher; it has to be learned.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 199, 2017-09-14, 18:43

text: If you want your troubles to end, remember Allah, do the zikr of Allah, make Allah dwell in your heart; the troubles will end. There is no other way besides this.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 203, 2017-10-19, 20:36

text: The haram has an effect of its own: through it, trust in the Messenger ﷺ becomes weak; one does not come to trust the words of the Holy Prophet ﷺ; then the whole matter turns towards the world.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 206, 2017-10-31, 11:05

text: Let your neck always bow in the court of Allah; never bow before anyone other than Allah: this is khudi. Khudi is not that you do not bow even before Allah.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 207, 2017-11-07, 03:17

text: Tawakkul is this: that the work is lawful, you make all the effort you can, and whatever result comes, you accept it; that is Allah's work.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 208, 2017-11-07, 32:30

text: See, Islam is not a claim; Islam is the name of action. If there is no justice in action, then what Islam is that? Oppression is not the name of Islam. Islam is the name of peace, and there is never peace in oppression.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 209, 2017-11-14, 09:19

text: Child, when hardship comes, repent. Review your character; your character will be put right, and the hardship will end.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 209, 2017-11-14, 15:22

text: When you do the zikr of Allah, the heart becomes clean; then whatever good you do, its spiritual state comes upon the heart.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 210, 2017-11-17, 03:59

text: The whole of Islam, the whole of faith, is trust in the Holy Prophet ﷺ. And if this is taken out from the middle, then nothing remains at all.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 211, 2017-12-04, 10:08

text: Do zikr, and do it night and day, do it every moment; do zikr of the heart. Verbal zikr does not have that power: the work that twenty years of verbal zikr would do, zikr of the heart will do in ten days.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 212, 2017-12-04, 05:26

text: Human nature does not change; it stays as it is. But its direction is turned away from evil and set towards good. This can be done; this is Islam.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Muhammad Akram Awan (RA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 212, 2017-12-04, 35:41

text: What is needed is that pain of the heart which makes us restless, which keeps this state alive at every moment: that I am in the presence of my Allah.
attribution: Hazrat Ameer Abdul Qadeer Awan (MZA) · Al-Murshid TV, Episode 216, 2018-01-08, 30:13
